mapper.select:
select ws.id, ws.laoren_id as laorenId, l.xingming as laorenXingming, hr.xingming as huliRenyuanXingming, ws.waichu_shiyou as waichuShiyou, ws.waichu_shijian as waichuShijian, ws.yuji_huiyuan_shijian as yujiHuiyuanShijian, ws.shiji_huiyuan_shijian as shijiHuiyuanShijian, ws.peitong_ren as peitongRen, ws.peitong_dianhua as peitongDianhua, ws.shenqing_ren_id as shenqingRenId, coalesce(ws.shenqing_ren_leixing, '历史数据') as shenqingRenLeixing, coalesce(ws.shenqing_ren_xingming, '') as shenqingRenXingming, ws.shenpi_zhuangtai as shenpiZhuangtai, sy.xingming as shenpiRenXingming, ws.shenpi_shijian as shenpiShijian, ws.shenpi_yijian as shenpiYijian, c.id as chuangweiId, c.chuangweihao, c.zhuangtai as chuangweiZhuangtai from waichu_shenqing ws join laoren_xinxi l on ws.laoren_id = l.id left join huli_renyuan hr on ws.huli_renyuan_id = hr.id left join xitong_yonghu sy on ws.shenpi_ren_id = sy.id left join chuangwei_shiyong cs on ws.laoren_id = cs.laoren_id and cs.shiyong_zhuangtai = '正在使用' left join chuangwei_xinxi c on cs.chuangwei_id = c.id
and coalesce(ws.shanchu_zhuangtai, '正常') = '正常'
and l.xingming like concat('%', #{laorenXingming}, '%')
and ws.shenpi_zhuangtai = #{shenpiZhuangtai}
order by ws.waichu_shijian desc, ws.id desc
select id, laoren_id as laorenId, shenpi_zhuangtai as shenpiZhuangtai from waichu_shenqing where id = #{id} and coalesce(shanchu_zhuangtai, '正常') = '正常'
mapper.update: update waichu_shenqing set shenpi_zhuangtai = '已回院', shiji_huiyuan_shijian = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.select:

and coalesce(ts.shanchu_zhuangtai, '正常') = '正常'
and l.xingming like concat('%', #{laorenXingming}, '%')
and ts.shenpi_zhuangtai = #{shenpiZhuangtai}
order by ts.tuizhu_shijian desc, ts.id desc
select id, laoren_id as laorenId, shenpi_zhuangtai as shenpiZhuangtai from tuizhu_shenqing where id = #{id} and coalesce(shanchu_zhuangtai, '正常') = '正常'

select cs.chuangwei_id as chuangweiId, cs.fangjian_id as fangjianId, c.zhuangtai as chuangweiZhuangtai from chuangwei_shiyong cs join chuangwei_xinxi c on cs.chuangwei_id = c.id where cs.laoren_id = #{laorenId} and cs.shiyong_zhuangtai = '正在使用' limit 1
mapper.update: update chuangwei_xinxi set zhuangtai = #{zhuangtai} where id = #{chuangweiId}
update laoren_xinxi set ruzhu_zhuangtai = #{ruzhuZhuangtai} where id = #{laorenId}
